Yemen Financial Inclusion Evidence

Accessibility statement

How this resource aims to be usable by everyone, what has not yet been tested, and how to report a problem.

Start with a questionVerify evidence
Understand → Explore → Verify

This resource presents the strongest defensible answer while keeping scope, limits and source visible.

01

Commitment

WCAG 2.2 is the reference this resource is designed and tested against. Meaning should not depend on colour, hovering or a mouse, and the Arabic edition should work fully right-to-left. This is a target, not a claim of verified conformance.

02

Charts and maps

Each chart and map should have a text description and a visible table or ordered list of its values. Evidence details should be reachable by keyboard, and essential values should not be hidden in tooltips that appear only on hover.

03

Testing status

Browser, keyboard, screen-reader, zoom and reflow, colour-contrast and right-to-left testing has not yet been completed.

04

Report an accessibility problem

Accessibility problems may be reported to office@causewaygrp.com. Include the page, component and language involved and, if useful, the browser or assistive technology being used. No response time has been published for this channel.

05

What this statement does not claim

This statement sets an accessibility target. It does not claim WCAG conformance until that testing has been completed.
